page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/skill.md` for the full workflow. Determines the Skill name from the request, checks `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` for an existing match, and either authors a new Skill (frontmatter, operating instruction, Scope, Workflow, Guidelines) plus its `.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` pointer, or revises the existing pair in place applying the same authoring judgment and scope discipline. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`.
